# SUPERHOT: MIND CONTROL DELETE ARCHIPELAGO VERSION 0.SCUFFED

## Requirements
[BepInEx x86](https://github.com/BepInEx/BepInEx/releases/tag/5.4.23.5), verified to work with version 5.4.23.5. NOTE: Most SUPERHOT mods use MelonLoader, however this mod is not compatible with MelonLoader at the moment, however a [tool exists to try and resolves this](https://github.com/toebeann/Tobey.BepInExMelonLoaderWizard). I have not verified this tool

## Install guide
- Client: Follow the [BepInEx install guide](https://docs.bepinex.dev/articles/user_guide/installation/index.html), then move the folder listed in the zip under plugins into BepInEx's plugins.
- [APWorld install guide](https://archipelago.gg/tutorial/Archipelago/setup_en)

## Usage
Edit the `connection_info.json` file found in `plugins/SUPERHOT_MCD_Archipelago` to fill in your host name, port, and slot name. The password field can be left blank if your room does not have a password, otherwise it must be filled with the password. After this, start the game and you should be connected! If nothing seems to have changed you probably aren't connected. Double check your information, and if it looks correct try checking the output log of the game.

## Why is this version scuffed?
This version represents absolute bare bones implementation I am willing to release. This content does not represent the final state of the mod, and is not something I'm proud of. I want to add further polish to the mod, such as making CACHE levels display the item they're about to send, as well as having GUI's for connecting and sending/receiving items. The mod is also filled with bugs that are willing to be found.

If you find any bugs, please report them in the [SHMCD thread in the Archipelago discord](https://discord.com/channels/731205301247803413/1544356897958658059).

Known bugs
- Mind and haack unlock views almost never display the correct contents

> [!NOTE]
> This mod only works on Windows at the moment. If you want a Linux version, ping me in the Archipelago discord and I'll whip one up. I intend to create a Linux version for the actual release.

> [!WARNING]
> This mod generates it's own save files in the save directory as the .dll, and does not dip into the main save file at all. However, I take no responsibility if your save file gets somehow deleted or altered.
